title: A pre-merge check's declared db service runs beside it in a real merge trial
description: A fixture's preMerge check declares a db Compose service and queries it at $GRAPHYARD_SERVICE_DB_HOST:$GRAPHYARD_SERVICE_DB_PORT. The real merge trial, with a stub docker first on PATH and a loopback TCP listener standing in for db, starts the services, waits for db to accept TCP and runs the check beside it: a working query passes, a failing one fails the trial, and the stack is torn down both times.

steps.name: a real trial runs the check beside its stubbed db service and tears it down
